attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Brodmann area 9 prefrontal cortex brain tissue was disected from frozen brain samples.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Total RNA was extracted with TRIzol (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA). RNA was purified using the RNeasy MinElute Cleanup columns (Qiagen Sciences Inc, Germantown, MD) and its quality was assessed with an Agilent Bioanalyzer Nano Chip 2100 (Agilent, Foster City, CA).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: 1.65 ug of purified total RNA from each sample was labeled with fluorescent dye (Cy3).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Labeled samples were hybridized to the microarray at 60 degrees C for 30 min; 55 uL 2X HI-RPM hybridization buffer (Agilent Technologies) was added; samples were then washed with washing solutions (Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Arrays were scanned with Agilent Microarray Scanner (Agilent), and the obtained images were analyzed with Agilent Feature Extraction software (v10.1, Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: The post dye normalized and post surrogate processed signal of the green channel was obtained with the Agilent Feature Extraction software (v10.1, Agilent Technologies). Log2 of quantile-normalized intensity values.
